card.name: First digit of a day in dates
card.fires_on: The first digit of the day number in a written date, right after a weekday name (e.g. Tuesday 22 March 2011). It appears mostly on science news pages and dated posts.

modes.label: Weekday then day number
modes.description: The leading digit of a day number after a weekday name, before the month and year.

modes.label: Month then day number
modes.description: The leading digit of a day number after a month name, with an ordinal ending following.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning already or reached, which suggests little to do with dates themselves.
card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of the day in a written date such as Tuesday 22 March.
